lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੀਐ ਚਰਣ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kee saranee pareeai charan ren man baachhai ||1||
lines.translation: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; my mind longs for the dust of their Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇ ਆਛੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jugat na jaanaa gun nahee koee mahaa dutar maai aachhai ||
lines.translation: I do not know the way, and I have no virtue. It is so difficult to escape from Maya!

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਪਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਾਛੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: aai paio naanak gur charanee tau utaree sagal duraachhai ||2||2||28||
lines.translation: Nanak has come and fallen at the Guru's feet; all of his evil inclinations have vanished. ||2||2||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mritaa pri bachan tuhaare ||
lines.translation: O Beloved, Your Words are Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਮਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: at su(n)dar manamohan piaare sabhahoo madh niraare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O supremely beautiful Enticer, O Beloved, You are among all, and yet distinct from all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj na chaahau mukat na chaahau man preet charan kamalaare ||
lines.translation: I do not seek power, and I do not seek liberation. My mind is in love with Your Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)draa mohi thaakur hee darasaare ||1||
lines.translation: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - I seek only the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master's Darshan. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen duaarai aaio thaakur saran pario sa(n)t haare ||
lines.translation: I have come, helpless, to Your Door, O Lord Master; I am exhausted - I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak prabh mile manohar man seetal bigasaare ||2||3||29||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have met my Enticing Lord God; my mind is cooled and soothed - it blossoms forth in joy. ||2||3||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jap sevak paar utaario ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, His servant swims across to salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal bhae prabh apane bahuR janam nahee maario ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When God becomes merciful to the meek, then one does not have to suffer reincarnation, only to die again. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam gun gaavah har ke ratan janam nahee haario ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and he does not lose the jewel of this human life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh gun gaai bikhai ban tariaa kulah samooh udhaario ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Glories of God, he crosses over the ocean of poison, and saves all his generations as well. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਉਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basiaa rid bheetar saas giraas uchaario ||
lines.translation: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within his heart, and with every breath and morsel of food, he chants the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ot gahee jagadeesur punah punah balihaario ||2||4||30||
lines.translation: Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord of the Universe; again and again, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਨ ਭੇਖ ਮੋਹਨ ਰਹਤ ਨਿਰਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karat phire ban bhekh mohan rahat niraar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Some wander around the forests, wearing religious robes, but the Fascinating Lord remains distant from them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨ ਗੀਤ ਨੀਕੇ ਗਾਵਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੇ ਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kathan sunaavan geet neeke gaavan man mahi dharate gaar ||1||
lines.translation: They talk, preach, and sing their lovely songs, but within their minds, the filth of their sins remains. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: at su(n)dar bahu chatur siaane bidiaa rasanaa chaar ||2||
lines.translation: They may be very beautiful, extremely clever, wise and educated, and they may speak very sweetly. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਏਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maan moh mer ter bibarajit ehu maarag kha(n)de dhaar ||3||
lines.translation: To forsake pride, emotional attachment, and the sense of 'mine and yours', is the path of the double-edged sword. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਅਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tin bhavajal tareeale prabh kirapaa sa(n)t sa(n)gaar ||4||1||31||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, they alone swim across the terrifying world-ocean, who, by God's Grace, join the Society of the Saints. ||4||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਰੀ ਊਚਾ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai pekhio ree oochaa mohan sabh te oochaa ||
lines.translation: I have seen the Lord to be on high; the Fascinating Lord is the highest of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਢੂਢਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan na samasar kooo laagai dhoodh rahe ham moochaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: No one else is equal to Him - I have made the most extensive search on this. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਗਾਹਰੋ ਥਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਅਗਹੂਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bea(n)t at bado gaaharo thaah nahee agahoochaa ||
lines.translation: Utterly infinite, exceedingly great, deep and unfathomable - He is lofty, beyond reach.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਮੋਲਿ ਨ ਮੁਲੀਐ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਰੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tol na tuleeai mol na muleeai kat paaeeai man roochaa ||1||
lines.translation: His weight cannot be weighed, His value cannot be estimated. How can the Enticer of the mind be obtained? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਪੰਥਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoj asa(n)khaa anik tapa(n)thaa bin gur nahee pahoochaa ||
lines.translation: Millions search for Him, on various paths, but without the Guru, none find Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਸ ਭੂੰਚਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa karee thaakur mil saadhoo ras bhoo(n)chaa ||2||1||32||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord Master has become Merciful. Meeting the Holy Saint, I drink in the sublime essence. ||2||1||32||
